title: rl_rob: A transparent, from-scratch Python library for teaching reinforcement learning from tabular methods to deep policy gradients
abstract: arXiv:2610.41303v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: rl_rob is an open-source Python library for teaching reinforcement learning. It implements the arc of a modern course, from tabular temporal-difference learning through linear function approximation to deep value-based and policy-gradient methods, with every algorithm written from first principles so that its update rule is visible in a few lines of code. All agents share one interface, so learners can compare methods directly across stages and trace a deep reinforcement learning update from the temporal-difference error to the weight change. The library supports teaching and assessment in which students implement, modify and explain update rules, rather than only produce working code.

translated_title: rl_rob：一个透明的、从零开始编写的 Python 教学库，用于教授从表格型方法到深度策略梯度的强化学习
translated_abstract: rl_rob 是一个用于强化学习教学的开源 Python 库。它实现了一门现代课程的完整脉络，从表格型时序差分学习，经过线性函数逼近，到深度价值方法和策略梯度方法，每个算法都从第一性原理编写，使其更新规则在短短几行代码中清晰可见。所有智能体共享同一接口，因此学习者可以直接跨阶段比较不同方法，并从时序差分误差到权重变化完整追踪一次深度强化学习的更新过程。该库支持让学生实现、修改和解释更新规则的教学与考核方式，而不仅仅是编写出能运行的代码。
tldr: rl_rob 是一个从零实现、接口统一的开源 Python 教学库，覆盖从表格型时序差分学习到深度策略梯度的完整强化学习算法体系，使学生能够实现、修改并解释算法的更新规则。
en_tdlr: rl_rob is an open-source Python library that implements reinforcement learning algorithms from scratch—spanning tabular temporal-difference learning to deep policy gradients—under a unified interface, enabling students to implement, modify, and explain algorithm update rules.
